title: Coordinates of a set indicator
statement: For every natural number $n$, every finite set $S\subseteq\mathrm{Fin}(n)$, and every $i\in\mathrm{Fin}(n)$, the $i$th coordinate of its binary indicator vector is $1$ if $i\in S$ and $0$ otherwise.
